results.title: 450 suspected yellow fever cases recorded across Ghana since June – Health Minister
results.description: Health Minister Kwabena Mintah Akandoh says health authorities have recorded about 450 suspected yellow fever cases across Ghana between June and September 2026, with the Upper West Region accounting for 74 of them.
